faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CMHO Dantewada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 October 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CMHO Dantewada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 RMNCH+A Consultant, 1 Consultant NVBDCP, 1 Social Worker.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CMHO Dantewada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 30 October 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer, Dantewada.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years (as on 1 May 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 35000 for RMNCH+A Consultant, 35000 for Consultant NVBDCP, 16500 for Social Worker.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS, B.D.S., B.A.M.S., B.P.T., B.H.M.S., M.P.H., M.H.A., Post Graduate Degree in Zoology or Life Science. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Local residents of Dantewada district will be given priority. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Government or semi-government employees without a No Objection Certificate. Applicants with incomplete applications. Applicants with criminal tendencies or misconduct.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Educational qualification percentage: 70 marks. Interview: 30 marks. Selection based on academic qualification marks (70%) and interview (30%).
